# M80 evidence intake: next functional boundary

Task `M80-EVIDENCE-BOUNDARY-CONTRACT-20260925`; CTO `/root/m80_beta_next_contract`, requested Astra/high, observed unknown. Design pending independent review. Accepted access-contract Candidate2 is a **prospective dependency**, not integrated working code. No real data, provider action or source release is authorized.

## Slice and honest reuse

Demonstrate authenticated creation -> streaming quarantine -> immutable provenance -> restart/status -> authorized synthetic download -> deletion receipt, through actual HTTP/native PostgreSQL/local object storage. Initially accept only exact operator-allowlisted synthetic PDF fixtures representing a Scope1 gas bill and supporting register. No extraction, transcription confirmation, calculations or document-completeness claim.

Current `apps/site-api/src/workspace/routes.ts` calls `File.arrayBuffer()`; `synthetic-bill-parser.ts` checks one fixed 4,605-byte PDF/hash and returns predetermined electricity data. Migration0002 stores originals as database `bytea` and extraction jobs as already completed. These are not general upload, quarantine or malware controls. Reuse connection/transaction primitives, hash conventions and authorization patterns; preserve these legacy paths unchanged. The accepted beta plan still requires real storage encryption, malware/type/size validation, confirmation, retention and independent end-to-end evidence.

## Files and persisted contract

Proposed implementation: `apps/site-api/src/beta-evidence/{routes,service,storage,scanner}.ts`; `packages/neuvetra-database/src/{beta-evidence-contract,beta-evidence}.ts`; separate `beta-evidence-migrations/0001_evidence.sql`; matching route/storage/native tests; `tools/beta-evidence/local-rehearsal.ts`. Integrate into the **accepted local** beta server only after access implementation review. Keep staging22 receipts/helpers/policies unchanged. Recheck actual access interfaces and migration ownership before coding; do not overwrite the concurrent engineer's files.

New module tables: `evidence` (company/evidence UUID, uploader, membership generation, year, fixture facility/source reference, evidence kind/period, declared and observed MIME/size/SHA256, object key/version, state/revision); `upload_attempts` (actor/request fingerprint, lease, completion receipt); immutable `scan_receipts`, `events`; `deletion_requests`. Composite company references and FORCE RLS; exact security-definer entrypoints only. Runtime cannot directly write tables, scan decisions or storage keys. Tenant owner uploads/deletes; active owner/member reads. Metadata/provenance corrections append successor records with reason; originals and scan history never change. Fixture source references are operator-seeded company/year-bound records, not caller-created foreign IDs. Original bytes are immutable; replacements create a new evidence ID with explicit supersedes linkage, preserving both provenance chains. Later real setup integration is separate.

## HTTP and streaming

All paths are `/beta-api/workspaces/:companyId/evidence`. Enforce prospective beta DB identity, active admission, membership generation and non-tombstoned tenant on every request; mutation checks again at commit. Uniform 404 for unauthorized/nonexistent objects, 401 authentication failure, 409 conflicting request/state, 413 oversize, 415 type, 422 metadata, 503 unavailable dependency. No company-wide hash lookup before authorization.

- `POST /uploads`: strict <=4KiB JSON `{requestId,fixtureId,reportingYear,facilityId,sourceId,evidenceKind,periodStart,periodEnd,declaredBytes,declaredSha256,declaredMime}`. Validate against exact synthetic manifest; server assigns evidence/attempt IDs and opaque object key. No filename/path/URL/actor/scan/release fields. Same authorized request/fingerprint returns its original attempt; changed payload conflicts. Reserve company quota atomically: two concurrent uploads, 20MiB retained bytes, 5MiB/file, ten-minute upload lease. Count reserved plus retained bytes; release reservation only after durable completion or verified cleanup, so failed uploads cannot evade quota.
- `PUT /uploads/:attemptId/content`: raw `application/pdf`, identity encoding, streamed counting/hash and bounded first-byte sniffing; never multipart or whole-request buffering. Reject compressed bodies, empty/oversize streams, misleading length, MIME/magic disagreement, declared hash/size mismatch. Cancel reader and close partial writer on failure. Content-Length is only an early rejection hint. No PDF parsing/rendering before quarantine. Rejected metadata does not read the content body; storage errors abort and quarantine the attempt.
- `GET /:evidenceId`: safe state/provenance only; no keys, scanner raw output or content. `GET /:evidenceId/download`: authorized attachment, server-generated filename, no-store/nosniff; no public object URL. `DELETE /:evidenceId` records deletion intent and returns 202 until storage deletion is verified.

Retries never append to a partial object. A live lease has one writer; expired attempts become abandoned, with a new explicit attempt required. Completed identical PUT retry checks current authorization and stored completion receipt, consumes/verifies the bounded resent stream, and returns the same receipt without rewriting storage. Different bytes conflict; no digest-only claim substitutes for streamed verification.

## Quarantine, scanner and crash consistency

Object adapter: `createExclusive(key)`, bounded `write`, `seal`, `openImmutable(version)`, `stat`, `deleteExact(version)`, scoped orphan listing. Local root is an exclusive task directory outside web assets; server-generated keys only, no user paths, symlinks/reparse traversal or overwrite. Seal durably before committing metadata. Persist reservation first; after writing revalidate lease/tenant/generation, then atomically record observed hash/length/version plus quarantine event. Failed commit leaves an inaccessible orphan, never a readable success. No database/filesystem atomicity is claimed.

State machine: `reserved -> uploading -> quarantined -> scan_pending -> verified_clean` or `rejected`; scanner timeout/error/unknown remains `scan_pending` with blocking reason. A leased worker/operator invokes scanning; no imaginary scheduler. Receipt must bind exact object version/hash/size, attempt nonce, scanner engine/signature versions, verdict and time. Only worker authority can finalize it through a revision/nonce compare-and-swap; this separate capability is unavailable to the HTTP runtime. Replay/stale receipt cannot override deletion/revocation or a newer scan. Missing, malformed or simulated verdict cannot produce `verified_clean`. A clean malware result alone does not validate PDF structure: sandboxed structural validation must also pass before real release; unsupported/encrypted/active-content PDF is blocked under the initial policy.

**Local functional branch:** exact manifest bytes may enter `synthetic_fixture_verified`, explicitly distinct from `verified_clean`, with `scannerAssurance: not_established`, `realDataEligible:false`. Only those exact fixtures can download in the local profile. Injected scanner cases exercise transition refusals but never prove malware safety; default scanner is unavailable. Hosted verified-clean download remains unimplemented/gated. Signature sniffing alone is not malware or structural validation.

Before download, open the pinned immutable version, verify full <=5MiB bytes/hash against authoritative metadata, recheck admission/generation/state, then serve the verified bytes; no unverified prefix escapes. Local bounded download buffering is acceptable. Revocation before this authorization point denies; an already authorized transfer may finish, but subsequent requests deny. Record that limit instead of promising instantaneous recall.

## Recovery, deletion and tests

Startup reconciler examines only this task's reservations/objects: expired partials and unreferenced sealed objects remain inaccessible and are deleted after a one-hour local grace period; ambiguous references are retained/quarantined with a failure receipt. Never adopt an orphan as evidence. Compare DB state/object version/hash; missing or corrupt objects block download after restart.

Deletion first tombstones evidence transactionally, immediately denying download and later worker promotion; then deletes exact object/partial versions and records completion. Failure stays `delete_pending` and retries idempotently. Tenant tombstone similarly denies all access and queues scoped cleanup. Retain minimal audit/provenance and deletion receipt; local fixture retention is 24 hours unless earlier deletion. This is a rehearsal policy, not approved customer retention. Restore must replay deletion/revocation tombstones before enabling access; backup purge is separately tracked, never inferred from primary deletion.

Native tests use a fresh task-named synthetic DB on `127.0.0.1:55472`, isolated storage root and restricted role. No private-backup clones, environment export, existing DB deletion or global-role changes. Exercise actual HTTP->adapter->SQL and storage: two tenants; malicious-looking safe fixtures; oversized/chunked/wrong MIME/hash; duplicate same-tenant content; no cross-tenant dedupe disclosure; path traversal; quota races; crashes before/after seal/commit; orphan reconciliation; scanner timeout/error/stale/forged/clean-simulation refusals; revoked uploader midstream; deletion versus scan/download; storage substitution; restart; exact authorized bytes; tombstone-preserving restore. Duplicate same-company hash reports existing evidence only after authorization; metadata differences require explicit linkage/correction, not silent replacement. Freeze old migration/helper hashes and verify unchanged state.

## Indispensable external decisions

Before real evidence: named data/privacy owner approves providers/region/subprocessors, company authority, data types and size envelope; storage owner verifies private buckets, encryption/key management, access separation and backup behavior; security owner selects/validates scanner plus isolated PDF validator, updates/timeouts and abuse limits; retention owner approves periods, deletion/holds and backup expiry; support owner approves audited access and incident handling. No vendor is selected or purchased here. Human source/method releases remain separate. Local acceptance can proceed without these decisions; real-data admission cannot.

Evidence checked: current fixed parser/upload/DB path, accepted beta plan and access Candidate2. No runtime tests or external actions performed. Independent review, integration and hosted acceptance remain pending.
